queries.query: In this repository, trace how a caller invokes a Cobra root command with command-line arguments through command selection to the selected command's execution. Explain the significant handoffs and error handling, naming the files and symbols that establish the path. Distinguish argument selection from parsing and execution. Cite source locations.

relevant.evidence: command.go:1070 Execute -> :1084 ExecuteC -> :1123 c.Find(args) -> :1148 cmd.execute(flags) -> :919 c.ParseFlags(a) -> :968 c.ValidateArgs(argWoFlags)

flag_groups.go:81 ValidateFlagGroups, called at command.go:1010 inside execute

irrelevant.evidence: test file; executeCommand helpers at command_test.go:32-59 are test scaffolding, not the production path
